meta_description:
36 likes, 3 comments - the_temptationalley on February 4, 2026: "This is sandwich of my dreams. It has creamy buratta, juiciness from the tomatoes and spicy kick from chilli flakes and herbs.
.
Ingredients - 2 sourdough slices 
- 1 heirloom tomato or normal tomato 
- 1 buratta 
- 1/4 tsp parsley, garlic powder, oregano each
- 1/2 tsp chilli flakes 
- salt as per taste 
- 4 tbsp olive oil 
- 1 tsp balsamic vinegar 
- 1 tbsp butter or olive 
- 1 grated garlic 
oil more to toast sourdough 
.
#sándwich #buratta #morningbreakfast #whatieattoday #whatimadetoday toastsandwich breakfasttoast parisfoodblogger parisfoodie sandwichoftheday sandwichrecipe quickrecipe easyrecipesathome".
